newsitem.title: USA: C.R. Bard backs Q4 estimates.
newsitem.headline: C.R. Bard backs Q4 estimates.

text.p: C.R. Bard Inc vice president for finance Duke Parker said Tuesday the company is comfortable with Wall Street estimates for the fourth quarter of sales of $315 million to $320 million and earnings per share of $0.52 to $0.54.
"We're looking at $0.52-$0.54 in earnings per share" to meet Wall Street estimates, Parker told investors at a Dain Bosworth conference here.
The medical device maker is forecast to earn $0.47 a share in its current third quarter and $1.96 a share in fiscal 1996, according to the First Call consensus of 12 analysts.
